comment: The Mihawk OS fork the ArtCraft edition builds on, and the commit mihawk/patches applies to with `git am`.

lapy_daemon_sha256.comment: The resident root-access daemon the title ships, built for one title id (tools/build-lapy-validation.py, payload SDK v0.42) with clang/LLD 23.1.3 as Arch Linux packages them (23.1.3-4; LLVM's own release names its git revision in .comment and so makes another file). PPSA99170 is Mihawk OS's pin, which that toolchain reproduces byte for byte (.github/workflows/daemon.yml); PPSA99278 is ArtCraft's, built the same way, and patch 0007 puts it into tools/build-production.sh.
